description: This source file implements the Configuration class for managing hostapd configuration files, including loading, storing, and modifying configuration parameters and VAP entries.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: A class for managing hostapd configuration files, including parsing, editing, and saving configuration parameters and VAP entries.

methods.name: operator bool
methods.description: Returns whether the configuration is in a valid state.

methods.name: update_required
methods.description: Checks if an update to the configuration is required.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads configuration from file, parsing header and VAP sections.

methods.name: set_create_head_value
methods.description: Sets or deletes a key-value pair in the header section.

methods.name: get_head_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a header key.

methods.name: get_vap_by_bssid
methods.description: Finds the VAP name associated with a given BSSID.

methods.name: set_create_vap_value
methods.description: Sets or deletes a key-value pair within a specific VAP.

methods.name: set_create_value
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair either in header or VAP section.

methods.name: get_vap_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a key within a specific VAP.

methods.name: disable_vap
methods.description: Disables a VAP by setting specific parameters.

methods.name: get_last_message
methods.description: Returns the last status or error message.

methods.name: get_vap
methods.description: Retrieves the VAP lines for a given VAP name.

methods.name: is_key_in_line
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in a line, considering comments.
